name: nftperp
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: On June 14, NFT perpetual contract trading platform nftperp announced on Twitter that a critical bug had been found in the clearingHouse contract. All vulnerable contracts have been suspended until further notice. On June 15, nftperp stated that all funds lost due to the vulnerability had been successfully recovered. The developers are currently prioritizing the resumption of the contracts so trading and withdrawal can go live.
